title: Create migrations for stock and transaction tables (stocks, stock_movements, transactions, transaction_items, transaction_payments)
acceptance_criteria: stocks table: id, outlet_id, product_variant_id, quantity, min_stock_alert, unique(outlet_id, product_variant_id)
stock_movements table: id, outlet_id, product_variant_id, type enum(in|out|adjustment|sale|return), quantity, reference_type, reference_id, note, created_by, created_at

transactions table: id, client_uuid (unique idempotency key), outlet_id, cashier_id, customer_id (nullable), invoice_number, subtotal, discount, tax, total, status enum(completed|voided|refunded), client_created_at, created_at
transaction_items table: id, transaction_id, product_variant_id, product_name_snapshot, price_snapshot, quantity, subtotal
transaction_payments table: id, transaction_id, payment_method_id, amount, change_amount, paid_at
client_uuid has a unique constraint for idempotency
Migrations run cleanly via Goravel artisan migrate
completion_summary: 5 migrations (stocks, stock_movements, transactions, transaction_items, transaction_payments) with unique client_uuid, composite stock unique, FK chains, status/type enums - ran cleanly
